SUNASG
0 - Unit is assigned
1 - Unit is not assigned
A unit is assigned if it is logically connected at present
to either MCP or the currently operating problem pro-
gram. This indicator exists in the channel status table
of single unit channels, and in the unit status table of
multi-unit channels. It is set by I-O assignment and
sometimes by special assignment and the I-O change
command. It is tested by the identifier, I-O assign-
ment, I-O change command, special assignment and
some actuator routines.
SUNSUP
0 - Unit is not suppressed
1 - Unit is suppressed
This indicator exists in the channel status table of
single unit channels, and in the unit status tables of
multi-unit channels.
The unit suppressed indicator
is set to 1 when an I-O interrupt has not been taken
for a specific unit. It is set by the receptor, and tested
by the identifier and the I-O change command.
SSETUP
0 - Not Setup operation
1 - Setup operation
This indicator exists in the channel status tables of
single unit channels, and in the unit status tables of
multi-unit channels. The setup indicator is turned on
by the actuator whenever control is to be returned to
the actuator for further processing of an I-O request.
It is set by the actuator, and tested by the receptor
and I-O change.
SOWNER
0 - Problem program
1 - MCP
This indicator exists in the channel status tables of a
single unit channel, and in the unit status table of a
multi-unit channel and shows what level of program is
the current owner of a particular unit. It is set by I-O
assignment, I-O change command, and special assign-
ment, and is tested by the receptor, identifier, 1-0
change command and special assignment.
